React

Create interactive interfaces from reusable components.

ROfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

React is a library for building interfaces from components, state, and user interactions. We can use it for filterable dashboards, multi-step forms, account workspaces, and responsive product journeys. The implementation focuses on predictable behavior: users should see clear loading, empty, success, and failure states while the interface remains consistent as a product gains features.

Useful outputs

  • Reusable interface components
  • Predictable interaction and data states
  • Documented UI behavior and integration boundaries

Where we can apply it

  • Analytics interface: selected filters → data view → detailed record panel.
  • Onboarding: user input → validation → next step → completion state.
  • Operations console: selected task → editable fields → confirmed backend action.
01

Use case 1

Build dashboards with filters, detail panels, and context-preserving navigation.

02

Use case 2

Create validated multi-step forms and guided configuration experiences.

03

Use case 3

Develop reusable components for a SaaS product or internal application.

Inputs we need

  • User journeys and component designs
  • Data contracts and interaction requirements
  • Accessibility and browser support criteria

Delivery sequence

  • Break the user journey into clear components and state ownership.
  • Connect data flows with explicit loading, validation, and error states.
  • Check keyboard operation, representative tasks, and important edge cases.

Expert review points

  • Review focus behavior and accessible control labels.
  • Verify state changes cannot display another user's cached data.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

Signals we can make visible

  • Task success rate
  • Form completion rate
  • Feature adoption
  • Client error rate
